article.title: TME live把BIGBANG香港演唱會延伸至山頂及市區
article.summary: TME live公布BIGBANG香港站的場外活動，讓樂迷在山頂廣場及市內地標接觸周年內容。
highlights: 山頂廣場設周年紀念空間，市內設免費打卡點。
主辦方另計劃以媒體藝術和互動體驗延續活動。
article.why: 旅遊零售及場地團隊可分開設計免費參與、到店兌換及付費體驗。
article.next_step: 與合作場地統一活動地圖、兌換條件和各點的參與統計。
article.detail: TME稱與YG Entertainment及合作方把COSMOS主題帶出場館，在山頂廣場設周年紀念空間，並在市內地標設屏幕和打卡點。主辦方亦計劃推出沉浸式媒體展覽，延長演唱會以外的互動。合作商戶可按場地逐一標明參與條件，並分開統計到訪和兌換。
article.title_en: TME live extends BIGBANG's Hong Kong concert to the Peak and city landmarks
article.summary_en: TME live announced offsite events that bring anniversary experiences to the Peak Galleria and landmarks across Hong Kong.
highlights_en: The Peak Galleria hosts an anniversary space, with free photo spots around the city.
Organisers also plan a media art exhibition with interactive experiences.
article.why_en: Travel retail and venue teams can design free participation, store redemption and paid experiences as separate steps.
article.next_step_en: Agree on a shared event map, redemption terms and participation metrics with venue partners.
article.detail_en: TME says it worked with YG Entertainment and partners to extend COSMOS beyond the concert venue, with an anniversary space at the Peak Galleria and screens and photo spots at city landmarks. Organisers also plan an immersive media exhibition to extend participation. Retail partners can state terms by location and track visits separately from redemptions.
